description: Adversarial accept/reject comparison between the TypeScript Epoch dispatcher and the Rust epoch-mcp binary, gating the Rust-replaces-TypeScript promotion.

methodology.typescript: src/dispatcher dispatch() — handlers Zod-parse first; raw cases use JSON.parse to mirror the transport layer.
methodology.rust: rust/target epoch-mcp binary driven with one JSON-RPC tools/call per case (one process per case for crash isolation).

severityModel.critical: Rust crashed or hung on input TypeScript handled.
severityModel.high: TypeScript rejects but Rust accepts (malformed input slips through after promotion).
severityModel.medium: Rust rejects but TypeScript accepts (functional regression).
